instructions_to_main_agent: Install Framer Motion: `npm install framer-motion` or `yarn add framer-motion`
Install React Fast Marquee: `npm install react-fast-marquee` or `yarn add react-fast-marquee`
Install Lucide React if not present.
Add Playfair Display and DM Sans to index.html or global css via Google Fonts.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the colors provided: primary (#1E3A2F), accent (#C9644B), secondary (#A1B29E), text_main (#1A221C), background (#F7F5F0), kraft (#D2B48C).
Extend tailwind theme for font families: font-heading (Playfair Display) and font-body (DM Sans).
Build the Hero Section first with a 3D-like floating layout. Use Framer Motion to float the three product images independently. Parallax the headline text.
For the size selector, use the kraft paper style with a slight rotation to mimic a physical tag.
Use standard semantic HTML, avoid massive custom components where Shadcn will suffice (e.g., FAQ Accordion).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='cta-buy-hero', data-testid='size-selector-m').
The 'Acheter' CTA should be an <a> tag linking to '#' for now as a Stripe placeholder.
Include a global grain texture div with mix-blend-multiply overlaying everything.
